title: Casino liquor and blackouts
summary: Grab drinks all over the casino, get progressively drunker, and drink too much to wake up somewhere unexpected.
notes: Stock whiskey, red wine, martinis, whiskey on the rocks and cosmopolitans at random on the casino bars and tables, restocking over time.
Count every sip as one drink of the existing intoxication, alongside bar beer and drinks.
Add swaying view and aim, double vision, weaving steps and stumbles that grow with each drink.
Black out on the eighth drink: collapse, then wake sober on a metro platform in your underwear with your clothes in your backpack.
